When enabled, FFmpeg copies the existing audio/video streams into the selected output container without re-encoding. This can significantly increase conversion speed and reduce performance overhead.

Because the codecs are not changed, the task may fail if the target container does not support a source stream's codec. If an error occurs, turn this option off and run the task again.

Choose the app theme display mode. Follow System switches between light and dark themes according to the device settings. Dynamic Color requires Android 12 or above. When Custom Background is enabled, you can use a selected image as the app background and choose whether theme colors come from that image or the system wallpaper.
The app interface will update immediately after switching. Some screens may need to be re-entered to take full effect.
Show conversion progress and completion alerts
When enabled, progress notifications will be shown during conversion, and success/failure alerts will be shown upon completion. System notification permission is required.
Unable to start the background task notification. Please try again
Automatically check for version updates on startup
When auto-check is enabled, the app will automatically check for version updates according to your selected frequency. When disabled, you can still manually check for updates on the About page.
Send anonymous usage and crash reports

When enabled, the app will collect anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to help us improve the app experience. This is important to us! It helps us catch issues that might otherwise go unreported. Of course, you can always report issues on GitHub as well.
